subject: NorthShore customer spotlight — mosaic case release & logo use
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Desai <priya@northshore.health>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: NorthShore customer spotlight — draft & logo usage request

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for taking the call last week — we really appreciate NorthShore's time and the thoughtful examples you shared. As discussed, we put together a short draft of a customer spotlight that highlights the Mosaic deployment and the latency/cost improvements. The draft and our standard release form are attached.

Could you review and let us know: (1) whether NorthShore is comfortable with the high-level language and metrics, (2) any copy edits needed (we can send a redline), and (3) which logo variants you prefer we use (full-color stacked, monochrome, or healthcare badge). If legal needs to be looped in, happy to add them.

We'd love to publish a short blog + customer blurb on the website in the next 10 business days if possible — totally fine if you need more time, we'll stagger.

Attachments: redwood_case-draft_v3.docx (customer spotlight draft), redwood_customer_release_form.pdf (permission checklist)

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Senior Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
E: evelyn@redwoodinference.com | M: +1 415-555-0118

Redwood Inference — Production-first LLM inference runtime

From: Priya Desai <priya@northshore.health>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samir Rao <srao@northshore.health>, marketing@northshore.health
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: NorthShore customer spotlight — draft & logo usage request

Hi Evelyn — thanks for the draft and for capturing the outcomes from the Mosaic rollout. We can move forward but need a couple of guardrails from our side:

- Please redact any internal patient identifiers and avoid using clinic-level KPIs that could be traced back to individuals.
- We would prefer the copy to call out the optimization as "query throughput and cost per inference" rather than the raw token metrics you have currently.

Legal (Samir) is cc'd to confirm the release language — he may ask for a small change to the duration clause. Once legal signs off, we can execute the release via DocuSign and share a logo pack.

Also: marketing@northshore.health prefers the stacked full-color logo for web, and a monochrome horizontal for slides.

Best,
Priya Desai
Director, Digital Strategy | NorthShore Health
priya@northshore.health

Hi Priya / Samir,

Thanks for the quick reply — I'm Jonas from Redwood Legal. I reviewed the attached release and proposed copy. We are fine with moving forward, subject to two small edits to the release:

1) Clarify that the anonymized metrics exclude any PHI and that Redwood will not publish any patient-level data.
2) Change the indemnity sentence to reference "claims arising from Redwood's use of the materials as permitted by the release."

I've attached a redline (redwood_release_review.pdf) that shows both edits inline. If NorthShore accepts these phrasing adjustments, we can route the updated release for signature via DocuSign.

Also: we'll need the logo pack and the preferred file formats (SVG + PNG) so design can optimize the assets. If marketing prefers, we can also accept a single ZIP with all variants.

Thanks,
